head: MS
raw_text: Answer: Charles' financial and job situation improved over time. His partner Margaret received a full-time job offer, bringing stability to their lives. Charles also found a less stressful new role, which positively impacted his mental health. Additionally, therapy sessions helped him cope with past challenges, including his father's passing, and focus on the present.
